invisbleman3.text: Still a fresh name on the board, and already fighting like a fixture: among the very best tracked on nearly every count, quick on the trigger, and unmoved when the opposition gets serious. The lifetime board agrees with the matchups, which is rare for a young account. Early days, but the opening chapters read like someone who arrived knowing the game.

igorrrrrr.text: IgOrRrRrR chooses the moment, then stands firm: sitting with the very best tracked, steady on the trigger, and holding their ground when the opposition gets serious. The lifetime board is split down the middle: the kill-death line agrees with the matchups, while the IvI line sits near the very bottom. The edge holds against the toughest third too, which is the mark of results that hold up under any lens.

isaiinztr.text: iSaiinZTR is a blur: matchup rating and activity both among the elite, with bravery to boot and a tempo that never cools. The accuracy sits at the very top, and the lifetime IvI ranks among the very best too. A player who turns each fight into a footrace and usually wins it.

inspijeoles.text: InSpijeoles plays the complete game: among the hardest chargers in the game, sitting at the very top, and dauntless whatever the fight demands. The lifetime IvI sits at the very top too, which makes the two boards agree. Against the hardest third, the edge dips a little: the lone blemish on an otherwise strong card.

iballistic8.text: iballistic8 keeps the tempo high: top shelf across the matchups, with pace near the top and results to match. Headshots run below average, yet the scoreboard stays strong regardless. The public board shortchanges this one: the career IvI line runs well below the matchup rating.

iamthealphaandomega.text: IAmTheAlphaAndOmega plays the long game beautifully: the rating, the pace, the courage, and the resistance all sit in the top ranks, with accuracy to match. The matchup kill-death mark and the lifetime board both sit above average, short of the summit, and consistency holds above average too. Read this one as an outline drawn from an older, smaller opponent sample, not a finished portrait.

ihatenanites.text: IHateNanites is a fresh account with a sharp opening: barely two weeks in, and already tempo near the very top, resistance to match. Bravery sits near the very bottom, yet the matchup kill-death mark lands near the top and the aim is the very best tracked. Early days, but the opening pages already carry real weight — a selective newcomer with elite hands.

incrediblystatuesquesublimegirl.text: IncrediblyStatuesqueSublimeGirl sets a relentless tempo: kills coming quicker than almost anyone tracked, bravery that climbs with the opposition, and resistance near the very top. Aim runs precise, a strong share of shots land as headshots, and the matchup mark sits well above average. Consistency is the one mid-pack wrinkle on an otherwise top-shelf record, and the lifetime board lines up with the matchups.

iviagicns.text: IVIagicNS is a tale of two cards: matchup rating just under the very top, resistance higher yet, and a matchup kill-death tally that matches — but consistency near the very bottom. Against the very best, the edge wears thin; the pace is middling and headshots are scarce. The lifetime board lands mid-pack, so the matchups flatter them a little — brilliant in the right fight, fragile in the hardest ones.

inimicusnc.text: InimicusNC has been at this since 2012, and the game still sits top-shelf: every adjusted line sits near the very top, their matchup kill-death figure close behind. The aim sits above average, headshots run mid-pack, and the lifetime board sits there too. The edge fades below average when the opposition is at its strongest, the lone soft spot in a long career.

inimicusvs.text: InimicusVS has played a top-shelf game since 2013: the matchup rating, the activity, and the resistance all crowd the very top, a matchup kill-death figure in step. The aim sits mid-pack, while the lifetime board lands there too, well below the matchups. Treat this one as a rough sketch rather than a finished portrait: the duels behind it come from an older, smaller pool.

idkhowididthat.text: idkHowIdidThat wins by volume and nerve: a matchup kill-death mark at the very top, resistance among the best tracked, and accuracy up near the top. The headshot share lands near the bottom, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack, so the matchups rate them clear of the lifetime board by a mile. A player whose results keep outrunning the explanations.

idgaffff.text: idgaffff plays at full throttle and never looks back: the tempo and the fight against stronger enemies both rank near the very top, with kills arriving faster than almost anyone tracked and the matchup grade running just as high. The aim is precise, headshots land near the top, and the lifetime numbers sit in the same elite bracket. A relentless, high-volume force.

Aim is sharp, headshots middling, and the results hold up as the opposition improves. Lifetime numbers put them above average, a notch below the matchups — a long career, still near the peak.

idf41i.text: IDF41I plays like a rising tide: rating and activity near the top, bravery and resistance right there with them, and the kill pace keeps up. ilostmymercy.text: ILostMyMercy arrived days ago and already plays like a fixture: activity, bravery, and resistance all near the top, with a matchup kill-death mark near the very top. Accuracy sits near the top, the headshot share too, and the lifetime numbers back the matchups. Early read on a young account, but the first pages already carry weight.

ivoxi.text: IVoxI builds on patience: resistance near the top and a matchup kill-death mark near the very top, with the lifetime kill-death board best of all tracked. Bravery sits mid-pack and the consistency mark dips below average, so the edge thins when the opposition hardens. Still, the aim stays steady and headshots land well above average, enough to keep the record elite.

icantaimwithoutaimassist.text: iCantAimWithoutAimAssist plays a relentless, high-volume game: activity and bravery near the very top, with pace and output both up among the highest tracked. The tempo runs above the middle, the aim ordinary, and the lifetime board sits a step behind the matchups. Consistency against the hardest third lands mid-pack, the only average line on the card.

The accuracy is near the top, the headshot share below average, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack — the matchups carry the story here. When the fights get hardest, the edge thins a little.

ilrambocatil.text: IlRamboCatIl brings a storm every time: a top-shelf rating, a blazing tempo, and a duel ledger that stays strong against the hardest opposition. ibulleti.text: ibulleti keeps it simple and keeps it working: matchup rating near the summit, resistance that absorbs the best fire going, and bravery that holds as fights get nastier. iiiimlgpotato.text: iiiiMLGPotato turns up ready every time: matchup rating in the upper echelon, bravery that keeps pace as the opposition gets tougher, and resistance that shrugs off stronger fire. iteemo.text: iTeemo has been around since 2015, and the matchups still rate them top-bracket: resistance that stands tall against stronger fire, bravery that keeps pace, and a head-to-head kill-death tally well above average. isaiinz.text: iSaiinZ has been winning fights since 2015, and the card still looks polished: rating, tempo, and bravery all sitting near the top, with accuracy and headshots landing right beside them. The grip against the hardest third rests mid-pack — a solid card with no loud weaknesses.

ikuncqcp.text: iKunCQCP plays at a sprint and never seems to tire: activity near the top, bravery keeping pace, and output among the swiftest tracked. ilovetooppress.text: ILoveToOppress plays with relentless pressure: in the upper reaches of the matchup board, activity and bravery both near the top, and a kill pace that never lets up. The tempo holds up, the aim stays sharp, and headshots land more often than most. Consistency sits mid-pack, the single ordinary line in an otherwise strong card, but the overall picture is a regular who keeps delivering.

isawyourtoesunderthedoor.text: iSAWyourToesUnderTheDoor is only weeks into the record books, so read this as an early sketch: a tempo near the top, bravery that rises as enemies toughen, and accuracy among the sharpest tracked. ifyungmetrodonttrustuimgonshootu.text: IfYungMetroDontTrustUimGonShootU never stops moving: tempo, bravery, kill pace, and output all near the summit, with accuracy and headshots above average too. isafu.text: Isafu fights like the clock is running out: bravery near the top, a kill pace to match, and pressure that never lets up. The aim runs above average, the headshots middling, and the whole card reads strong. A regular who turns every fight into a sprint and usually wins it.

ijieri.text: IjierI has been around only since 2026, yet already plays like a headline act: tempo and bravery run near the very summit, kill pace keeps up, and accuracy, headshots, and the lifetime board all land in the top ranks. The wrinkle is consistency, which sinks near the bottom against the strongest third. Early read, but the opening is impossible to ignore.

indubioproreo.text: Indubioproreo has been winning quietly since 2014: above average on nearly every line, from rating and tempo to resistance and kill pace. The aim and headshot share sit mid-pack, and the lifetime board lands in the same middle ground. A veteran whose card reads like a long, steady career — no flash, just fight after fight won.

iodinenc.text: IodineNC has fought since 2012 with a card that is strong nearly everywhere: rating, tempo, bravery and resistance sit above average; the lifetime board trails close behind. The one wrinkle is consistency, which sits near the bottom against the strongest third. A veteran whose headline is steadiness everywhere except where it counts most.

imsupercool.text: imsupercool is a study in contrasts: accuracy among the sharpest tracked, a duel kill-death figure near the top, and a lifetime kill-death line to match. Yet the headshot share sits near the bottom and the lifetime IvI line runs low, so the lifetime board undersells the matchups badly. The pace is middling — this one wins on placement, not volume.

iagoofyi.text: IAgoofyI fights with a scorer's touch: a head-to-head kill-death line near the summit, a matchup mark sitting clear of the middle, and bravery that keeps up as foes get stronger. Headshots land below average and the aim sits mid-pack, so the results outrun the raw shooting. When the opposition hardens, the edge fades a touch — the one wrinkle in a strong card.

icantdecide69.text: ICantDecide69 plays at a gallop: bravery up near the summit, output running at a near-top rate, and consistency that holds against the hardest third. The duel kill-death count lands mid-pack, which keeps the story honest — the volume is the weapon, not the finishing. Lifetime numbers read mid-pack too, in step with the matchups.

iibulletii.text: iiBULLETii has been fighting since 2016, and the card stays well above average: steady against stronger opposition, hard to kill, and a solid kill pace. The brawl ledger remains well above average, and lifetime numbers to match. When the fighting gets toughest, the edge slips below average, the one soft seam on a veteran card.

iamtheblackwizards.text: IamtheBlackWizards has been fighting since 2012, and the matchup card still carries weight: the rating sits above the middle, and activity, bravery, and resistance sit there too, with a kill-death split in duels to match. The lifetime figures sit mid-pack, a step below the matchups, and the aim lands in the same middle ground. The edge fades against the strongest third — the one soft seam in a long, solid record.

immortaltickinsearchforaspoon.text: ImmortalTickInSearchForASpoon is a tale of two thirds: resistance near the very best, and the level-field kill ratio near the top — until the opposition gets toughest. Facing the hardest opposition, the edge falls away sharply, near the bottom of the consistency scale. The lifetime board reads mid-pack, the aim stays above average, and the results hold up everywhere except where it matters most.

infamousleopard.text: InfamousLeopard hunts the headshot: the headshot share sits among the elite few, and the lifetime board lines up with the matchups. The duel kill count stays well above average, though the lifetime kill-death board lands mid-pack. A veteran since 2014 whose aim writes the headlines while the rest of the card quietly holds its ground.

invisiblegh0stvs.text: INVISIBLEGH0STVS plays at full sprint: tempo near the very best, accuracy to match, and headshots landing with rare regularity. Bravery holds near the top as the fighting hardens, while the head-to-head return stays well above average. The one soft seam is consistency — versus the toughest opposition, the edge dips below average, the lone wrinkle on a card that otherwise gleams since 2017.

idolatrizeproto.text: IdolatrizeProto has fought since 2013, and bravery is the signature: it holds near the top as enemies get stronger, backed by tempo and resistance well above average. The matchup rating follows, and the kill-death spread lands above the middle too. A veteran who leans into the hardest fights and usually comes out ahead.

icctr.text: ICCtr is a matchup-board player with a strange split: well clear of average in the matchups, unruffled as the opposition hardens, and carrying the lifetime kill-death balance at a near-top rate. Yet headshots are nearly absent, and the lifetime IvI sits near the bottom. A card that rewards a second look, because the two halves refuse to agree.

icekobetea.text: iceKobetea plays a game with no weak seam: well above average across the whole matchup board, level as the opposition hardens, and sharp with every shot. The pace runs above the middle, the headshots land often, and the lifetime ledger backs the matchups up. A regular already playing like a fixture, with nothing left to prove on any single line.

invisiblegh0sttr.text: INVISIBLEGH0STTR has fought since 2017, and the card reads like a masterclass in pressure: comfortably clear of the middle in the matchups, brave as the opposition hardens, and moving at a clip few tracked players can follow. The aim and the headshots both land near the very top; the lifetime record reads top-shelf. Only the edge against the toughest third thins out, the one blemish on a veteran card.

ickypanther.text: IckyPanther wins the fights that matter by showing up for them: bravery near the top, a kill pace to match, and resistance that holds firm. The kill-death arithmetic of the matchups lands well clear of average, and the edge survives the strongest third. The aim is middling and the lifetime board reads mid-pack — the results come from nerve and tempo, not precision.

ilessicetr.text: ILessICETR plays the complete game: above average on every matchup count, unmoved against the strongest third, and headshots that land with remarkable regularity. Accuracy sits in the middle, the one modest line, while the lifetime board reads taller than the matchups. A strong, even card with no weak spot to speak of.

ianalysti.text: IAnalystI plays a steady, well-rounded game: above the middle across the matchup card, sharp aim in tow and a game that holds as enemies toughen. The headshots land rarely, and the lifetime board runs plainer than the matchups. The quiet strength is how the edge holds up best against the hardest third.

ibebanned.text: IBeBanned is barely a month into the record books and already playing like a fixture: among the fastest-moving players tracked, with a sharp aim and headshots that land often. The toughest opposition takes a toll, the one soft spot so far. Early read, but the opening chapters are loud.

imconnortheandroidfromcyberlife.text: ImConnorTheAndroidFromCyberLife plays at full throttle: among the quickest movers tracked, with output to match and a game that holds up as enemies toughen. Sharp aim, yet the headshots rarely land — a body-shot game, through and through. The lifetime board comes out plainer than the matchups, but the engine never stops.

imrightyourwrong.text: Imrightyourwrong has been proving the point since 2013: above the middle on nearly every matchup count, with a tempo that never lags and a game that stands up as enemies toughen. Nothing on the card is flashy and nothing sags — the lifetime board tells the same steady story as the matchups. A veteran regular, still turning up and still holding their own.

infoloser.text: Infoloser pairs a sharp eye with a soft seam: accuracy among the sharpest tracked, yet consistency against the strongest third runs below average. The matchup rating, the tempo, and the matchup kill-death arithmetic all run above average; the lifetime board echoes the matchups. Since 2024, a regular with one clear wrinkle on an otherwise strong card.

iwillshootyouifyouseeme.text: IWillShootYouIfYouSeeMe plays at full tilt: bravery and tempo both near the top, accuracy and headshots among the sharpest tracked, and a matchup kill-death record to match. The matchup rating sits above average, the lifetime board runs near the top, and consistency holds mid-pack. A regular who brings the fight to the other side, every time.

ironironheads.text: IronIronheads is the matchup board's paradox: the kill-death balance in matchups sits near the very top, resistance too, yet the lifetime board sits near the bottom. The headshots land near the bottom as well, and the edge crumbles against the toughest third. A regular whose matchups punch far above the lifetime record — the card reads like two different stories.

ilbopohiil.text: IlBOPOHIil plays a full-throttle, high-tempo game: upper tier in the matchups, quick between fights, and steady as the enemies improve. Headshots land often enough, and the lifetime numbers back the matchups up. The soft spot: when the fights get hardest, the edge falls away sharply.
